article_blocks.text: Strain Type: 60% Sativa / 40% Indica
Genetics: Gas Drop × Deep Space Candy × Jamaican Pearl
Breeder: Ziplock Seeds × Sensi Seeds
THC Content: 25%
CBD Content: N/A
Terpene Profile: beta-caryophyllene , limonene , myrcene
Primary Flavors: Diesel, Fermented Grapes, Burgundy Wine
Flowering Time (Indoor): 65–70 Days
Outdoor Harvest Time: October
Indoor Yield: 400–550 g/m²
Outdoor Yield: 475–650 g per Plant
Grow Difficulty: Moderate

Gun Smoke captures the tension between two very different traditions in cannabis breeding: the aggressive fuel aromas of contemporary American hybrids and the vibrant tropical character of classic Caribbean sativas. Developed by Ziplock Seeds in collaboration with Sensi Seeds, this cultivar combines dense, resinous flowers with an unusually layered fragrance of fermented grapes, burgundy wine, fresh citrus, and pungent diesel. Its genetic background is equally distinctive, drawing from the modern Gas Drop and Deep Space Candy families while incorporating the celebrated Jamaican Pearl.

The result is a sativa-dominant marijuana strain that refuses to behave like a conventional energizing variety. Mental euphoria arrives first, followed by an increasingly comfortable physical calm that makes the experience particularly appealing during the transition from an active day to a relaxed evening. With substantial yield potential, vigorous growth, and impressive aromatic complexity, Gun Smoke represents an ambitious meeting of established European breeding and modern American cannabis genetics.
Genetics and Lineage

The foundation of Gun Smoke consists of a Gas Drop and Deep Space Candy hybrid crossed with Jamaican Pearl, producing an approximately 60% sativa and 40% indica genetic composition. Ziplock Seeds developed the cross through its Hawaiian breeding operations as part of the Sensi Seeds Breeding Grounds collaboration. This arrangement brought together specialized American selections with one of Sensi Seeds’ recognizable heritage varieties. The breeding objective emphasized vigorous development, rich aromatic expression, and a balance between uplifting mental effects and substantial physical relaxation.

Gas Drop provides much of the powerful fuel character associated with the finished hybrid. Developed by Ziplock Seeds, this parent combines Gas Face and Frosted Flakes. Gas Face incorporates Face Mints and Biscotti -Sherbet-related genetics, while Frosted Flakes descends from Cereal Milk and White Truffle . These ancestral connections introduce several influential modern cannabis families associated with pungent aromas, dense flowers, and heavy resin production. Deep Space Candy contributes a contrasting element, bringing sweet confectionery characteristics and additional aromatic complexity. The selection has also earned recognition in cannabis competitions, including an indoor flower award at the 2025 NECANN Cup.

Jamaican Pearl supplies the historical counterweight to these contemporary genetics. Originally developed by Sensi Seeds from Marley’s Collie and Early Pearl, it was created to preserve desirable tropical sativa characteristics while improving adaptability to cooler European climates. Marley’s Collie contributes Caribbean-influenced sweetness and cerebral stimulation, whereas Early Pearl supports vigor and earlier maturation. Jamaican Pearl’s ancestry helps explain the pronounced stretch, productive lateral branches, and mentally uplifting opening effects of Gun Smoke. Combining these traits with modern gas-heavy genetics creates a hybrid that expresses qualities rarely encountered together in conventional dessert or Kush varieties .
Effects and Experience

The Gun Smoke experience opens with a noticeable shift in mental energy. An uplifting wave of euphoria may create a lighter emotional atmosphere, making conversations more engaging and everyday surroundings feel unusually interesting. This initial phase has a distinctly cerebral quality, although it does not necessarily produce the restless stimulation associated with some traditional sativas. Creative activities, music, and relaxed social interaction may become more absorbing as the euphoric sensations develop. The Jamaican Pearl ancestry is consistent with this bright beginning, while the influence of the other parents contributes greater depth to the overall experience.

Physical relaxation gradually becomes more prominent as the initial mental intensity settles. Instead of abruptly replacing euphoria with sedation, the effects may develop into a comfortable combination of psychological ease and reduced bodily tension. The body can begin to feel heavier while the mind remains pleasantly occupied, creating a contrast between mental engagement and physical stillness. This progression makes the cultivar particularly associated with late afternoons and evenings, when a final period of enjoyment can transition naturally into quieter activities. Higher amounts may encourage drowsiness, although the degree of sedation differs between individuals.

Potency deserves consideration because the strain incorporates several genetics associated with substantial THC production. Without a verified laboratory average, however, its precise strength cannot be reliably expressed as a fixed percentage. Consumers with limited THC tolerance may experience stronger-than-expected intoxication, including dizziness, anxiety, dry mouth, or temporary difficulties with concentration. The balanced character described by the breeder does not guarantee a mild experience. Dose, individual sensitivity, and consumption method remain important determinants of the effects.
Medical Benefits

Gun Smoke may interest medical marijuana patients seeking psychological uplift alongside physical relaxation, although clinical research evaluating this specific cultivar is unavailable. Certain THC-containing cannabis products have demonstrated modest benefits for some forms of chronic pain, particularly neuropathic discomfort. The combination of initial euphoria and gradually developing bodily calm may appeal to patients who prefer relaxation without immediate overwhelming heaviness. Nevertheless, the genetic composition alone does not establish effectiveness for pain, muscle spasms, or other medical conditions. Treatment outcomes depend on cannabinoid concentration, dosage, and the individual’s health circumstances.

Stress-related complaints represent another possible area of interest. The uplifting beginning may temporarily improve subjective mood, while the later relaxing effects could make it easier to disengage from everyday pressures. Some individuals may also find the physical calm compatible with evening rest or sleep preparation. However, high-THC marijuana can aggravate anxiety in susceptible patients, and evidence regarding long-term cannabis use for insomnia remains inconsistent. Sedation should not automatically be interpreted as improved sleep quality, particularly when repeated exposure produces tolerance.

Medical use requires greater precision than recreational strain descriptions can provide. Patients should review laboratory-tested cannabinoid concentrations and consider possible interactions with prescription medications. THC can impair judgment, affect cardiovascular function, and intensify the effects of certain sedating substances. Anyone managing chronic illness or taking medication should discuss cannabis use with a qualified healthcare professional. The cultivar may provide subjective symptom relief for some people, but it is not an established treatment for any specific disease.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

Few cannabis varieties combine fermented fruit and petroleum-like pungency as distinctly as Gun Smoke. During flowering, the plant develops an aroma that moves between dark grapes, burgundy wine, zesty citrus, diesel fuel, and subdued earthy musk. The fruit character differs from the straightforward sweetness of candy-oriented hybrids. It has a richer, slightly fermented quality reminiscent of crushed wine grapes, with citrus brightness preventing the fragrance from becoming excessively heavy. Beneath these aromatic layers lies a strong OG-style gas character that gives the cultivar its unmistakable intensity.

After harvesting and curing, the fragrance becomes more concentrated and integrated. Breaking apart the dried flowers releases pungent diesel first, followed by darker fruit sweetness and fresh citrus peel. During consumption, the flavor generally begins with a rich, fuel-forward impression before developing into wine-like grape notes and tangy citrus. An earthy, musky aftertaste remains as the sweeter elements fade. This progression creates a sensory experience that begins aggressively and finishes with greater subtlety. Proper curing is particularly important for preserving the contrast between volatile citrus compounds and deeper, heavier aromatic components.

A comprehensive laboratory-confirmed terpene profile has not been publicly established for this weed variety . Beta-caryophyllene could contribute spicy or woody characteristics, while limonene may help explain some citrus impressions. Myrcene is another possible contributor to its earthy and musky qualities. These associations should not be confused with verified measurements, since cannabis fragrance also depends on numerous other volatile compounds. The fermented grape character, in particular, cannot be attributed confidently to a single terpene without detailed chemical analysis.
Growing Information

Gun Smoke develops into a relatively tall marijuana plant with vigorous vegetative growth , extended internodal spacing, and long lateral branches. Indoor specimens commonly reach approximately 100–160 centimeters, while outdoor plants can approach 300 centimeters under favorable conditions. The branching structure creates a broad, productive canopy, but considerable vertical stretch can occur during the first weeks of flowering. This characteristic requires attention when cultivating in rooms with limited overhead space. The mature flowers are generally conical and relatively small individually, yet their tightly stacked calyxes produce substantial density. Light green surfaces, pale pistils, occasional purple coloration, and abundant resin contribute to their distinctive appearance.

Indoor flowering usually requires 65–70 days, making the cultivar slower to mature than many compact indica-dominant hybrids. Under favorable conditions, yields may reach approximately 400–550 grams per square meter. Outdoor specimens have the potential to produce 475–650 grams per plant, depending on available sunlight, seasonal conditions, and overall development. The strain’s relatively low proportion of leaf material within the mature buds can simplify individual trimming tasks, although the considerable number of flowers may make harvest processing time-consuming. Dense buds and substantial resin coverage also make appropriate airflow and humidity management important during the final stages of flowering.

The growth pattern is particularly compatible with Screen of Green cultivation , which allows the extended lateral branches to occupy a wide, evenly illuminated canopy. Mainlining and other structural training methods may also help manage the plant’s natural vigor and encourage more uniform flowering sites. Conversely, Sea of Green arrangements are generally less suitable because of the extended internodal spacing and pronounced stretch. Despite its Hawaiian breeding background, the cultivar inherits useful cool-climate adaptability from Jamaican Pearl and can perform in a range of environments with sufficient light. Outdoor harvest timing depends on local seasonal conditions, while indoor growers should evaluate flower maturity rather than relying exclusively on the calendar. The plant is best suited to cultivators comfortable managing taller hybrids and their substantial branching structures.
FAQ
Is Gun Smoke an indica or sativa strain?

Gun Smoke is a sativa-dominant hybrid containing approximately 60% sativa and 40% indica genetics. Its ancestry combines Gas Drop, Deep Space Candy, and Jamaican Pearl. The experience typically begins with cerebral euphoria before developing into noticeable physical relaxation. Despite its sativa dominance, the later effects can feel considerably calming rather than continuously energizing.
What is the THC percentage of Gun Smoke?

A standardized, breeder-confirmed THC percentage has not been established for the Ziplock Seeds and Sensi Seeds version. Its ancestry suggests considerable potency potential, but cannabinoid concentrations can vary significantly between individual plants and harvests. Laboratory results from the specific cannabis product provide the most dependable indication of strength.
What does Gun Smoke taste like?

The flavor combines pungent diesel, fermented grapes, burgundy wine, sweet citrus, and earthy musk. Fuel-like notes dominate the initial impression, while darker fruit and citrus become more noticeable afterward. The lingering finish is earthy and slightly pungent, creating a more complex experience than a conventional gas-dominant weed variety.
How long does Gun Smoke take to flower?

Indoor flowering generally requires approximately 65–70 days. Mature plants typically reach 100–160 centimeters indoors and can grow considerably taller outdoors. The breeder estimates indoor yields of 400–550 grams per square meter, although actual production depends on plant development and environmental conditions. Outdoor harvest dates vary with latitude and seasonal weather.
Is Gun Smoke difficult to grow?

The cultivar presents moderate cultivation difficulty. Its vigorous growth and substantial flowering stretch require adequate vertical space and canopy management, particularly indoors. Long lateral branches respond well to Screen of Green techniques, while the plant’s relatively hardy genetics support cultivation in cooler climates. Experienced growers may find its productivity rewarding, although careful attention to plant structure and moisture control remains important.
Final Thoughts on Gun Smoke

Gun Smoke represents a distinctive meeting of modern American gas genetics and traditional Caribbean-influenced cannabis breeding. Its complex ancestry incorporates the pungent intensity of Gas Drop, the confectionery qualities of Deep Space Candy, and the vigorous sativa characteristics of Jamaican Pearl. Together, these selections produce resin-rich flowers with an unusual fragrance that combines fermented grapes, sharp citrus, earthy musk, and substantial diesel pungency.

The experience is equally layered, beginning with expressive mental euphoria before moving toward sustained physical relaxation. Growers have a productive, vigorous hybrid capable of substantial harvests, although its tall structure and extended flowering period require thoughtful management. For cannabis enthusiasts who appreciate intense fuel aromas but also want fruit complexity and uplifting effects, Gun Smoke offers a recognizable personality within the increasingly diverse world of contemporary marijuana genetics.
